subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------TRS.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 247 (CMOA(II)-5). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), DY-FT (dynamic functionalism), POL-DY (political dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From INFO-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From DY-FT: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From POL-DY: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From MT-INFO: DOC (documentation). From AF-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: INT (intention).
